next_step_summary: PR #277 is a bounded corrective follow-up after two logger-specific warning-cleanup attempts still left non-actionable library warnings in the local single-contract CLI. The CLI now contains no web-UI import or web-UI logger configuration. Instead it disables Python logging at WARNING level for the CLI process before shared analysis modules are imported, while runner-owned cycle/status/error messages continue through print/controlled exceptions. This is intentionally broad only for library warning-level logging in this command-line process; ERROR/CRITICAL logging remains enabled. Provider routing, retry cycles, Question Engine extraction/validation, privacy gates, OCR scope, report persistence, model list, dependencies, permissions, workflows, endpoints and network destinations are unchanged. The canonical next step remains `question-engine-single-contract-real-rerun-v4`: rerun the same reviewed March-August 2025 contract and inspect explicit answers for `security.realization_chain`, `security.return_mechanics`, `security.completion_authority`, `termination.notice_cure`, and `termination.cross_clause_interaction` before broadening to other contracts.
